hero_sub: Weddings, feasts, stages, runways and roads. Photographed, cooked, produced and told by one crew from Kolkata.
manifesto: Dariya means river. Since 2017 we have followed one current through Kolkata's weddings, kitchens, boardrooms, runways and roads. Five houses grew from it, each with its own craft, all sharing one crew, one standard and one place to start the conversation.
clients_line: Hotels · Resorts · Government bodies · Fashion labels · Restaurants · Families across Bengal
address: New Town, Rajarhat, Kolkata, West Bengal

faq.q: How far ahead should we book for a wedding?
faq.a: Wedding season dates (November to February) go first, so most couples reach out several months ahead. Smaller events and shoots can often be arranged in a few weeks. Send your date and we will confirm availability.

faq.q: Can one team handle photography, films and catering together?
faq.a: Yes. That is why the group exists. Book any combination of Dariya Events, Dariya Gourmet and Qafila and you deal with one team from first call to final delivery.
Yes, our kitchen is FSSAI approved. Ask for the licence details along with your menu quote.

faq.q: When do we receive our photos and films?
faq.a: You get a first look soon after the event, then the full edited gallery, films and album. Exact timelines are written into your quote so you know what arrives when.

faq.q: We are a brand. How do we work with Qafila or Raviya?
faq.a: Send a short brief through the form below with your dates, city and what you want to achieve. We reply with a plan, crew and quote.
